name: writhing_stalker.live_light_continuity_mcw
description: Native light-continuity spoke: a night lamp is visible to a saved stalker while the player uses only advertised movement/wait owners, allowing same-run light sample, expiry and waypoint evidence.

steps.label: post_load_light_continuity_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: night lamp and one hostile stalker load in the disposable current-source world

steps.label: audit_saved_night_before_light_continuity
steps.abort_reason: saved turn does not prove the physical lamp is active at night

steps.label: audit_saved_stalker_before_light_continuity
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters metadata lacks the required isolated stalker state
steps.expected_visible_fact: one hostile same-roof stalker starts adjacent to the lamp, behind an opaque player-LOS break, with no retained direct or light memory

steps.label: operate_native_light_continuity_window
steps.objective: Use only advertised native movement and wait actions; perform explicit pre/post native audits of direct-target absence, light sample/source/observed/expires/waypoint fields, then stop refreshing the lamp and inspect the owner after the declared expiry.
proof_targets: same-run light sample id/source/observed turn/expiry turn/waypoint
post-expiry light-memory and waypoint clear or contract-defined stop
source, receipt, witness and cleanup binding
invariants: no player identity, direct target, scent or noise knowledge explains the waypoint

evidence_contract.claim: a physically visible lamp produces stalker light memory that persists across native turns, commits a waypoint and expires at its bounded turn
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load proof only / inconclusive for stalker light continuity
evidence_contract.writeback_note: No save/writeback gate: the claim is same-run native continuity and bounded expiry.
